Thank you for providing the reduced reproduction for Issue #36902.

It is helpful to know that removing the try/catch block or storing
user?.access_token in a variable beforehand resolves the issue. This
suggests the compiler may be having trouble tracking property access within
the try block during dependency inference.

We will look into why the inferred dependencies are becoming less specific
in this context.
